svg.title: Cecil routes emergency data through a battery audio coupler and old cloth-covered cable.
svg.desc: A short data lead enters a two-cup audio coupler before the stained cloth-covered patch cord. Cecil monitors the conversion while Babul-da answers the Hall line and learns that the utility crew has arrived with a live order.
svg.text: Page 50, panel 6 · Comic wide shot of Cecil bridging a data lead, audio coupler and cloth-covered cable

text.tspan: The coupler carries the digital emergency record
over the old voice circuit, and the live Hall call

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
